columns.comment: Calendar month of the watchlist event or month-end membership as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the watchlist event or month-end membership, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Row type: Event (register event) or Month-End Membership (client on the list at the month-end).
columns.name: Record Type

columns.comment: Event rows: Added (left Green), Escalated (to Red), De-escalated (Red to Amber) or Removed (back to Green).
columns.name: Event Type

columns.comment: Lead reason of the event (membership rows: of the client's latest event), e.g. Credit deterioration (health / utilisation / covenant), Deposit outflow, Wallet migration to competitors, Adverse external news.
columns.name: Reason

columns.comment: Dominant EWS driver: Credit, Liquidity, Behavioural or External.
columns.name: Lead Category

columns.comment: RM owning the watchlist action (membership rows - the owner of the client's latest event); fictional name.
columns.name: Owner

columns.comment: Event rows: action required - Watchlist credit review (Added), Recovery / exit plan (Escalated), Monitoring update (De-escalated).
columns.name: Action Type

columns.comment: Event rows: status of the action plan at 30-Sep-2026 - Completed, Open (not yet due) or Overdue.
columns.name: Action Status

columns.comment: Membership rows: final EWS band of the listed client at the month-end (Amber or Red).
columns.name: Watchlist Band

columns.comment: Clients on the credit watchlist at the month-end (point-in-time; Is Latest Month = today, 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: Watchlist Clients

columns.comment: Drawn lending exposure of the clients on the watchlist at the month-end, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Watchlist Exposure USD

columns.comment: IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisions of the watchlist clients at the month-end, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: ECL on Watchlist USD

columns.comment: Exposure at default of the watchlist clients at the month-end, USD (from Apr-2024; point-in-time).
columns.name: EAD on Watchlist USD

columns.comment: Watchlist clients whose final EWS band is Red at the month-end (point-in-time).
columns.name: Red Watchlist Clients

columns.comment: Average days since the clients were (last) added to the watchlist, at the month-end.
columns.name: Average Days on Watchlist

columns.comment: Watchlist additions in the selected months (a flow).
columns.name: Added

columns.comment: Watchlist removals in the selected months (a flow).
columns.name: Removed

columns.comment: Escalations to Red in the selected months (a flow).
columns.name: Escalated

columns.comment: Additions minus removals in the selected months.
columns.name: Net Additions

columns.comment: Watchlist action plans overdue at 30-Sep-2026 (status today, for the events in the selection). Actions come from events of every month - for "actions overdue (by owner)" do not filter Month or Is Latest Month.
columns.name: Actions Overdue

columns.comment: Watchlist action plans not yet completed at 30-Sep-2026 (Open or Overdue), from events of every month - do not filter Month or Is Latest Month.
columns.name: Open Actions

columns.comment: Average days past due of the overdue action plans at 30-Sep-2026 (events of every month; do not filter Month).
columns.name: Average Action Days Overdue

comment: SMBC APAC credit watchlist, Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: clients on the watchlist at each month-end with their drawn exposure, EAD and IFRS 9 ECL (point-in-time: filter a Month or Is Latest Month = today; a longer period returns its last month-end), Red names, days on the list; watchlist events per month (added, escalated, de-escalated, removed - flows) with reason and owner RM; and review actions overdue / open at 30-Sep-2026. Grain: one row per watchlist event or per client x month-end on the watchlist (gold.mvb_watchlist).
